overall_assessment: Section extraction works well for HVO: the fixed heading structure (Om emnet, Læringsutbytte, Praktisk organisering, Vilkår for å framstille seg til eksamen, exam table) maps cleanly, learning outcomes keep all three sub-groups, and arbeidskrav land in coursework_requirements. Only low-severity noise was found; all six pre-pass flags are false alarms.

findings.evidence: I samsvar med det nasjonale kvalifikasjonsrammeverket har studenten følgjande læringsutbytte etter fullført emne:
findings.description: Every learning_outcomes row starts with the standard NQF boilerplate sentence, which is not an outcome. The outcomes themselves are complete.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The boilerplate is the first line under the Læringsutbytte heading and .clean_sections() has no rule for it.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a leading-line strip in .clean_sections() (or an hivolda-specific rule) for lines matching '^I samsvar med det nasjonale kvalifikasjonsrammeverket'.

findings.evidence: Vurderingsform	Gruppering	Varighet	Karakterskala	Andel	Kommentar	Hjelpemidler	Omfang
findings.description: Assessment is the exam table as tab-separated rows with a repeated column-header line and many empty cells. The content is correct (form, duration, scale) but the header row is noise in every course. The pre-pass 'boilerplate' flag on ENG144 is this identical header line, not a real problem.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Table flattening keeps the header row; identical header text in many courses triggers the boilerplate flag.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop the fixed header row when flattening the HVO exam table (or reformat rows as labelled fields), so only data rows remain.

findings.description: A reading_list row was emitted containing only a link caption. In the other courses the 'Pensumliste for emnet finn du her' placeholder is correctly dropped, so handling is inconsistent. The reading list text itself is never on the page (only a link), so reading_list is absent for nearly all HVO plans.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The placeholder filter matches only the 'Pensumliste for emnet finn du her' wording, not the older 'Sjå pensumliste for emnet her'.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the reading_list placeholder pattern to cover '^Sjå pensumliste for emnet her$'.

findings.description: Prerequisites row holds 'none, see admission requirements', a placeholder pointing to admission rules, while the Bokmål variant in DRHS900-2 ('Ingen. Se opptakskrav i studieplanen.') was dropped. Inconsistent; the row carries no prerequisite.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Placeholder filter for 'Ingen' variants matches only the bare word or the Bokmål spelling.
findings.suggested_fix: Treat '^Ingen\.? (Sjå|Se) opptakskrav' as a placeholder in prerequisites cleaning.
